description: List returns the authenticated principal filed (buyer-side view), paginated. Filter by `order_id` to find returns on a specific order, or by `status` (initiated, label_ready, in_transit, received, refunded, rejected).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from next_cursor in the previous page; omit for the first page.

order_id.description: Filter to returns for one order.

status.description: Filter to a single return status; omit for all statuses.

name: returns_list
title: Returns list
